supported_claims: All three frozen observations share count K=3, hence a fixed-prior Beta Bernoulli posterior and count check are blind to their order.
Observed equal adjacent transitions 4, 0 and 2 produce different exact posterior predictive adjacent-tail checks.
For the alternating observed sequence, one-sided upper tail is 1 while lower tail is less than 0.05 across all three frozen priors.
limitations: All nine frozen observed sequences and 576 source types are artificial.
Posterior predictive discrepancy tail probabilities are not classical uniform frequentist p values and have no real-world validation.
No causal, psychological, historical, new out-of-sample predictive evidence or original paper dataset replication.
